description: This file defines the SandboxNodeVisitor class which implements the NodeVisitorInterface for the Twig templating engine. It handles traversing and modifying Twig AST nodes to enforce security policies and wrap certain nodes for security checks within Twig templates.

classes.name: Twig\NodeVisitor\SandboxNodeVisitor
classes.description: Implements a node visitor for Twig AST that adds security checks and node wrapping for sandboxed templates.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Traverses into a node, initializing or updating security-related tags, filters, and functions, and wrapping nodes as needed for security.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Handles cleanup or final modifications when leaving a node, including injecting security check nodes at the end of a ModuleNode.

methods.name: wrapNode
methods.description: Wraps a specific node node's expression with a CheckToStringNode to enforce security and ensure safe string conversions.

methods.name: wrapArrayNode
methods.description: Recursively wraps array expression nodes within a parent node for security.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this visitor, which determines when it is run relative to other visitors.
